name: Spicy Cajun Shrimp, Sausage & Veggie Sauté with Mashed Cauliflower

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head cauliflower
4 sticks celery
2 orange bell peppers
2 medium zucchini squash
1 small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot with about 1-inch of hot water from the tap; cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, cut cauliflower head into quarters, then trim off and discard the leaves and thick stem; roughly chop into bite-sized pieces.
Once the water in the pot is boiling, add cauliflower, reduce heat to medium, and cook until tender, about 10 minutes.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, cut sausages crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausage and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy and cooked through, 5-7 minutes. Using a slotted spoon, transfer sausage to a plate, leaving the cooking juices in the skillet.
While the sausages are cooking, using a clean cutting board, trim and slice celery crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces; place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into ½-inch thick half-moons. Add both to the bowl with the celery.

When the sausage is done, return skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add veggies, tomatoes, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, about 8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 (14.5 oz) cans diced tomatoes
1 ½ tsp salt
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
1 tsp paprika
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp oregano, dried
½ tsp thyme, dried
¼ tsp cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the cauliflower is done, drain in a clean colander. Working in batches if necessary, transfer to a blender along with cream cheese, butter, and spices; purée until smooth. Return to the pot, cover, and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ (8 oz) block cream cheese
4 tsp butter, unsalted
½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp onion powder
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are tender, add sausage and shrimp to the skillet; stir to combine and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sausage is warm and shrimp are cooked through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the parsley to the skillet and stir to combine (reserve the other half for serving).
To serve, divide cauliflower mash and shrimp-sausage sauté between plates or bowls. Sprinkle with reserved parsley and enjoy!
